question: How much distance will be covered in 2.5 hours at a speed of 40 km/h?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Distance = Speed × Time

Distance = 40 × 2.5

Distance = 100 km

**∴ The correct answer is 100 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed = 40 km/h

Time = 2.5 hours

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1086f3abb3bbbd84d6d4ac385ab190ec0edd1ebdeb6d0bbfc2c263f67fcce85e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Distance = 40 × 2.5

⇒ Distance = 40 × (5/2)

⇒ Distance = 20 × 5

⇒ Distance = 100 km

**∴ The correct answer is 100 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Relation

Speed = Distance ÷ Time | Time = Distance ÷ Speed.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply the speed by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. If a person travels two equal distances at speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y).
